data.rationale: Commit 30d4a6daac8b updates how PostgreSQL parses XML data in CONTENT mode by switching from xmlParseBalancedChunkMemory to xmlParseInNodeContext with XML_PARSE_NOBLANKS enabled. This affects xml_parse, xmlparse, xmlserialize, and xml_is_document when processing XML in CONTENT mode or validating DOCUMENT/CONTENT well-formedness. The fragment adds grammar rules for XMLPARSE in CONTENT and DOCUMENT modes, XMLSERIALIZE formatting with INDENT, and expressions using the IS DOCUMENT predicate on XML values.
data.grammar_fragment: expr : <0.5> XMLSERIALIZE "(" (DOCUMENT | CONTENT) XMLPARSE "(" (DOCUMENT | CONTENT) xml_text_expr xml_space?0.4 ")" AS "text" INDENT?0.4 ")" | <0.3> "(" XMLPARSE "(" CONTENT xml_text_expr ")" "::" "text" ")" ; xml_space : PRESERVE WHITESPACE | STRIP WHITESPACE ; xml_text_expr : <3> CONCAT "(" "''" "," expr "," "''" ")" | <2> "(" "''" "||" "(" "chr(65279)" "||" "'abc'" ")" ")" | <1> "'12'" ; expr : <0.5> "(" "(" XMLPARSE "(" CONTENT xml_text_expr ")" ")" IS NOT?0.3 DOCUMENT ")" | <0.4> "(" "(" expr "::" "xml" ")" IS NOT?0.3 DOCUMENT ")" ;
seeds: SELECT XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLPARSE(CONTENT '<?xml version="1.0"?>' || chr(65279) || 'abc') AS text INDENT);
SELECT (XMLPARSE(CONTENT CONCAT('', c1, ''))) IS DOCUMENT FROM t0 WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL;
SELECT XMLSERIALIZE(DOCUMENT XMLPARSE(DOCUMENT CONCAT('', c1, '')) AS text INDENT) FROM t0 WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL;
